$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/<folder>.js). The build registers every type listed here; docs/CONTRACT.md §1. split: the analysis parts (h3-js, Terra Draw, the swipe, the PMTiles basemap) load on first use (§42).

views.name: Map
views.summary: Rows on a map and the analyses a map answers: markers, clustered or proportional points, heatmap, H3 hexagons, choropleth and bivariate regions, flows, routes, rings, catchments, within-a-distance, callouts, 3D columns, time playback, small multiples, a swipe and a drawn area; a bundled Natural Earth world map, or a self-hosted OpenStreetMap .pmtiles basemap; or a floor plan in metres. A click opens a row or a region's rows, or picks them on a dashboard (select:); a counted marker asks which.
